args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 3.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
- Bumps `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 3.1.0 in `requirements.txt`.

## Reason
CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions: >=2.8.0 <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Since we migrated to fastjson 3.x last sprint, this upgrade (approved by the code owner) takes the 3.x fix, 3.1.0.

## Testing
- CI passed on this branch.
